headline_hook: Opus 5 Ships at Half the Fable Price as FLUX 3 Drops and Context Engineering Gets New Rules
preview_topics: Opus 5's frontier debut at half the cost
the new rules of context engineering

pick_of_the_day.thesis: Anthropic publishing a 'new rules' guide for their own models reveals that prompt engineering isn't converging on universal principles — it's fragmenting by model generation, and builders who don't retool their context strategies per-family are leaving real performance on the table.

model_literacy.relevance: With Opus 5 launching and Anthropic publishing explicit new prompting rules for the Claude 5 generation, the shift from 'prompt engineering' to 'context engineering' — orchestrating system prompts, tool definitions, examples, and conversation history as a unified context-window strategy — is no longer theoretical. Model providers now expect developers to treat the full context as an engineering surface, not just the user message.
